rawRecord.short_description: Secure terminal and filesystem access with configurable command filtering, file operations, and system monitoring.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides terminal command execution, filesystem operations, and system process monitoring through a configurable security model. Supports command allowlisting and blocklisting, timeout controls, and output size limits. Includes tools for running shell commands, reading and writing files, listing directories, checking file existence, and inspecting running processes and environment variables.
